dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: I'm Genta, the Arataki Drumalong Festival Welcome Ambassador.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Are you ready for your Drumalong performance?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Oh, you wanna take part in the Drumalong performance again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's showtime.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Let the Drumalong begin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, about this drum...

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: You noticed it too, huh? Yeah, I noticed almost straight away that something wasn't quite right.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: It looks exactly like the kind of toy drum I'd buy from street peddlers as a kid! I remember they only cost around 800 Mora back then.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Times change, I guess, but still. 80 grand is way too expensive.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: The boss definitely got scammed, no question.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: But whaddya gonna do? He's still the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, about Arataki Itto...

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: You wanna know when Boss is getting back? Sorry, I have no idea.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: What I do know is that the boss and Shinobu both see this festival as a major event, so they hope to get as many people to come as possible. That's why they're out there working hard to promote it.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: They said this will improve the image of the Arataki Gang, but I wouldn't know anything about that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Still, I think he'll be back to see you before it's over.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: After all, he respects you a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, I'm not ready yet...

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: No problem. Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes please.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: I wanna see your performance again, too, but the Tenryou Commission has ordered us to put everything on hold. You're putting me in a difficult position here...

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Ooh, I know! Since it's you, we can say we're friends hanging out and having fun.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission won't be able to say anything against that, hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: This is a pretty genius idea, isn't it? I mean, at least half as genius as Boss's ideas?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Bring it on, Traveler! Begin your performance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay, I'm just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a pity. I wanted to see your performance again.
